countPolicy: Counts physical nonblank noncomment lines in seven new self-contained R70 production and verification files and three new substantive test files. Excludes generated data, receipts, screenshots, documentation, fixtures, lock files and prior dirty-tree code. The two attributable integration lines in a tracked existing component are counted separately. R70 adapters in earlier untracked browser drivers are disclosed but conservatively not credited because their previous-round local baseline cannot be reconstructed from Git.
